author: ojiudezue
title: v5.104.0 shipped: NM diag text menu + read-only house_status; WhatsApp and Companion inbound fixed
summary: NM diag text menu + read-only house_status; WhatsApp and Companion inbound fixed
why: Operator wanted to query house state by text. Deterministic menu first because the OC agent still fails its eval on diagnosis depth; the house_status layer is reusable as OC tools. Digits 1/2/3 already mean ack/status/silence, so menu digits are windowed with an alert-active check and close-on-send; diag replies bypass the reply floor so safe-word confirmations are never dropped. WhatsApp inbound had been silently dead (wrong payload keys) and the bridge runs on the operator's own number, so only self-chat is trusted.
implications: Shipped NM-INBOUND-HOUSE-QUERIES-1 at v5.104.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.104.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: iMessage diag returns live values; if the WhatsApp self-chat check shows no inbound rows, the bridge never forwards fromMe

refs.release_notes: Text diag (or menu/house) to get a numbered house-status menu: doors, garage, who, hvac, energy, alerts, health. Reply with a number inside 2 minutes or text a name any time. Alert reply digits 1/2/3 keep their meaning whenever an alert is active. WhatsApp inbound now works from the operator self-chat only; HA app replies now answer.
